en.headline: Observatory says September was hotter and drier than normal
en.dek: The mean minimum of 27.1 degrees was the fifth highest on record for September, and rainfall was about 29 percent of normal.
body: September was hotter and drier than usual because the upper-air anticyclone over southern China was stronger than normal, the Hong Kong Observatory said on Monday.

The mean minimum temperature was 27.1 degrees, 1 degree above normal and the fifth highest for September on record. The mean temperature was 28.8 degrees and the mean maximum 31.8 degrees, 0.9 and 1.3 degrees above their respective normals. Mean relative humidity was 74 per cent, 4 percentage points below normal and one of the sixth-lowest Septembers on record.

Rainfall totalled 94.3 millimetres, about 29 per cent of the normal 321.4 millimetres. Rainfall for the first nine months of the year was 2,451.9 millimetres, about 9 per cent above the normal for the period. Seven tropical cyclones affected the South China Sea and the western North Pacific in September. Of those, Severe Tropical Storm Sader affected Hong Kong, and the Observatory issued the No. 1 standby signal.

zh.headline: 天文台：9月較正常炎熱乾燥
zh.dek: 9月平均最低氣溫27.1度，是有紀錄以來9月第五高；總雨量94.3毫米，約為正常的29%。
body: 香港天文台星期一表示，由於華南高空反氣旋較正常強，今年9月較正常炎熱及乾燥。
9月平均最低氣溫為27.1度，較正常值高1度，是有紀錄以來9月第五高。平均氣溫28.8度，平均最高氣溫31.8度，分別較正常值高0.9度及1.3度。平均相對濕度74%，較正常值低4個百分點，是有紀錄以來9月其中一個第六低。
9月總雨量只有94.3毫米，約為正常值321.4毫米的29%。本年首9個月累積雨量2451.9毫米，較同期正常值多約9%。9月有7個熱帶氣旋影響南海及北太平洋西部，其中熱帶氣旋沙德爾曾影響本港，天文台當時發出一號戒備信號。
